The "Do Anything" Clause

This is the heart of the license. It gives permission to:

  • check Use the code for free.
  • check Modify it however you want.
  • check Merge it with other code.
  • check Sell copies of it (yes, you can sell MIT code!).

The Only Condition

There is only one rule you must follow:

You must keep the license text and the original copyright holder's name in your copy of the software.

Translation: "Don't delete the LICENSE file. Give credit where credit is due."

The "Don't Sue Me" Clause

The text is in ALL CAPS because, legally, warranty disclaimers must be conspicuous.

  • gavel No Warranty: If the code deletes your database, the author is not responsible.
